text: Foreign citizens who are physically and mentally healthy and of good conduct. Applicants for master's degree programs must have a degree equivalent to a bachelor's degree in China, and applicants for doctoral degree programs must have a degree equivalent to a master's degree in China. No criminal record. During the study period in China, I voluntarily abide by Chinese laws and regulations as well as the school's rules and regulations, respect Chinese social morality and customs, and refrain from engaging in any activities that are inconsistent with my student status.
